title: CHECO26: A China-wide cross-thematic raster database at 1-km resolution for ecological research
description:
A uniform-grid library of 21,110 environmental layers covering China at 1 km in an equal-area Albers projection (WGS 84, central meridian 105°E, standard parallels 25°N and 47°N).

Twenty-one dataset entries drawn from nineteen source products across eight categories (bioclim, soil, lulc, anthro, hydro, vege, dist, topo) are standardised to one grid of 4,861 × 4,062 cells, one data type (float32) and one NoData convention (−9999).

Besides the harmonised source layers the database delivers 16,286 focal-statistics layers at four radii (1, 5, 10 and 20 km), 17 distance surfaces, and per-cell areal proportions for every categorical source. Land use and land cover is provided at three complementary depths: annual observed cover 2000–2025 (CLCD, 1,170 layers), a China-relevant projection (GLU1km, 540 layers) and a harmonised yearly reconstruction 1960–2100 under five SSP-RCP scenarios (18,440 layers).

Total volume is 169.4 GB. The full layer manifest ships with the repository as one semicolon-separated row per layer.
notes: Per-layer licensing differs across the source products; see the layer manifest and the project repository for details before redistributing individual layers.
